svg.title: Amplifier dock - plan sheet
svg.text: State: planned - its CAD is Y73. Rulings: D-503 D-608 D-609. Part folder: 00-design/amp-dock/
against the bin box in the passenger-side cargo bin, its fins in open air away from the battery (D-609)
Its board waits on the amplifier's pick (luxury X-012), then the CAD pass (Y75).
the DSP amplifier (luxury LP57, not picked) and the home-built upmix (LP56) built as its connector board, the digital link between them inside (D-503, D-609)
L4-AMP, one HDP20 24-29: every speaker output, the head unit's line-level pair with its drain, the remote; power by two short bolted leads from the bin box (C13 from F34, C14 to the negative bus)
Amplifier + : F34 in the bin box -> the amplifier dock's bolted + lead
4 AWG sized for the largest amplifier class luxury 03.13 leaves
open (about 100 A fused); the run stays inside the bin. Fed
from the disconnect's output, so the disconnect kills the
amplifier (D-466). confirm — hand estimate, not measured
Amplifier - : the amplifier dock -> the bin box's negative bus
Its own return to the star, never the body panel (D-274,
